launcher.add_hint: Create this task using Super Productivity short syntax.
launcher.capture_hint: Type a task after /sp. You can use Super Productivity short syntax.
launcher.open_app_hint: Launch or focus the desktop app.

additional_info_mode.description: Select what additional information to display in the bar widget.
additional_info_mode.label: Additional info mode

auto_start.description: Starts the desktop app in the background when the companion is unavailable.
auto_start.label: Start Super Productivity automatically
auto_start.rest_description: Starts the desktop app when the service needs it and Super Productivity is not running.

bridge_dir.description: Optional path to the companion data directory. When empty, Noctalia detects the path automatically.
bridge_dir.label: Bridge directory override

follow_active_task.description: Automatically switch the widget to the active task when tracking starts or changes in Super Productivity.
follow_active_task.label: Follow active task

glyph.description: Icon shown beside the task title.
glyph.label: Widget glyph

hide_when_no_active_task.description: Hides the bar widget when no task is currently running.
hide_when_no_active_task.label: Hide when no active task

launch_method.description: Method Noctalia uses to start or focus Super Productivity.
launch_method.label: Launch method

max_title_chars.description: Limits task titles to this number of characters in the bar widget.
max_title_chars.label: Maximum title length

max_upcoming.description: Maximum number of due tasks available when scrolling the widget.
max_upcoming.label: Upcoming task limit

native_command.description: Executable name or absolute path that Noctalia uses to launch Super Productivity. Do not include arguments.
native_command.label: Native command

notify_due.description: Shows a notification when an upcoming task reaches its due time.
notify_due.label: Due notifications

overdue_text_color.description: Color used for overdue task text in the bar widget and details panel.
overdue_text_color.label: Overdue text color

poll_seconds.description: How often Noctalia reads the companion state, in seconds.
poll_seconds.label: Refresh interval

prefer_tracked_task.description: Places the currently tracked task before due tasks while its timer runs.
prefer_tracked_task.label: Show tracked task first

rest_token_file.description: Optional path to Super Productivity's local REST API token file. An empty value enables native and Flatpak discovery.
rest_token_file.label: REST token file override

show_timer_controls.description: Shows start and stop tracking controls in the expanded details panel.
show_timer_controls.label: Show timer controls

sound_on_complete.description: Plays a sound after Super Productivity confirms task completion.
sound_on_complete.label: Completion sound

status.bridge_error: The companion bridge reported an error
status.bridge_error_hint: Automatic refreshes and exact-task opening require a working companion bridge.
status.bridge_protocol_mismatch_hint: Rebuild the companion package and reinstall it with the matching Noctalia plugin version.
status.bridge_stale: The companion bridge status is stale
status.bridge_stale_hint: Automatic refreshes and exact-task opening may be unavailable until the companion reconnects.
status.bridge_starting_hint: REST provides task data. The companion provides automatic refreshes and exact-task opening.
status.bridge_unavailable_hint: Automatic refreshes and exact-task opening require the companion.
status.companion_missing: The Super Productivity companion is not installed or enabled
status.companion_outdated: The installed companion needs an update
status.companion_outdated_hint: Rebuild the companion package and reinstall the generated ZIP in Super Productivity.
status.error: The local REST API request failed
status.hook_error_hint: Changes made in Super Productivity require manual Refresh until the notification error is fixed.
status.hook_protocol_mismatch_hint: Rebuild the companion package and reinstall it with the matching Noctalia plugin version.
status.package_ready_hint: Open the package folder. Then select the ZIP file in Super Productivity.
status.protocol_mismatch: The companion protocol version is incompatible
status.rest_auth_required_hint: Enable the local REST API in Super Productivity Settings → Misc. If needed, set the REST token file override to the active local-rest-api-token file.
status.rest_error: The local REST API request failed
status.rest_error_hint: Super Productivity must be running with its local REST API enabled. Refresh retries the request.
status.rest_stale_hint: Noctalia could not refresh task data. Refresh retries after the REST connection is restored.
status.rest_starting: Loading task data from the local REST API…
status.rest_starting_hint: Noctalia is connecting to the local REST API in the Super Productivity desktop app.
status.rest_unavailable: The local REST API is unavailable
status.rest_unavailable_hint: Super Productivity must be running with its local REST API enabled. Refresh retries the connection.
status.setup_hint: Build the companion package. Install it in Super Productivity. Approve the file-access prompt. Then select Refresh.

task.none_due_hint: Use quick capture below or add a due date in Super Productivity.
task.unavailable_hint: Task loading and actions require a local REST API connection.
